summary: Liberty Defense Holdings (NASDAQ: DETX, a foreign private issuer filing a Form 6-K, the US equivalent of a current report on Form 8-K) disclosed that John R. Percival was appointed Chairman of the Board effective immediately, replacing Executive Chairman Jason Burinescu, who departed to pursue other full-time opportunities. No shareholder vote, price, stake or transaction terms were disclosed. The filing is an abrupt, event-driven board leadership change and a non-routine succession item. Watch for follow-on disclosures on board composition, any strategic review or financing, and leadership-driven execution risk.
